# What does a new patient cost you, and what are they worth?

> Free chiropractor new patient ROI calculator: cost to acquire a patient, patient lifetime value by segment, payback in visits, and the most you can spend per lead. Works for physical therapy and wellness clinics. Runs in your browser, nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
